nativeServer.command: dotnet publish AgroServer/AgroServer.csproj --no-restore -m:1 -c Release -f net10.0 -r linux-x64 -p:PublishAot=true -p:SkipSpeciesGeneration=true -o /tmp/gf-contact-v31/native-server

ccd.limitations: 20 micrometres per-body offset; rational-to-float conversion; 20 deforming edge queries excluded; sampling is not a proof

diffCheck.command: git diff --check -- Agro/AgroWorld.cs Agro/Collisions/OrganPose.cs Agro/Collisions/StaticCollider.cs Agro/COLLISIONS.md; git diff --no-index --check /dev/null <new documentation file>
diffCheck.scope: three changed source files and appended/new documentation; all unrelated dirty work preserved
